RYDIA-WHIP.description: Gain 5 [gold]Summon[/gold] at the start of your turn and 3 [gold]Summon[/gold] from Attacks
RYDIA-WHIP.flavor: A well-worn whip whose links hum softly with the promise of something much larger.
RYDIA-WHIP.title: Chain Whip
RYDIA-ICE_WHIP.description: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]1[/blue] [blue]Freeze[/blue] to ALL enemies.
RYDIA-ICE_WHIP.flavor: Cold to the touch. Colder to everything it touches.
RYDIA-ICE_WHIP.title: Ice Whip
RYDIA-FLAME_WHIP.description: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
RYDIA-FLAME_WHIP.flavor: Handle with care. Or don't. That's what the flames are for.
RYDIA-FLAME_WHIP.title: Flame Whip
RYDIA-BLITZ_WHIP.description: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Shock[/gold] to ALL enemies.
RYDIA-BLITZ_WHIP.title: Blitz Whip
RYDIA-STARDUST_ROD.description: At the start of each combat, add a random [gold]Eidolon[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
RYDIA-STARDUST_ROD.flavor: A slender rod dusted with light from a sky far beyond the Spire.
RYDIA-STARDUST_ROD.title: Stardust Rod
RYDIA-MYSTIC_WHIP.description: [gold]Eidolon[/gold] cards deal [blue]25%[/blue] more damage. Gain [blue]2[/blue] additional [gold]Summon[/gold] at the start of each turn and whenever you play an Attack.
RYDIA-MYSTIC_WHIP.flavor: Every crack echoes somewhere beyond the veil, and something always answers.
RYDIA-MYSTIC_WHIP.title: Mystic Whip
RYDIA-FAERIE_ROD.flavor: It occasionally moves when nobody is looking.
RYDIA-FAERIE_ROD.title: Faerie Rod
RYDIA-ICE_ROD.flavor: A crystalline rod that makes an already bad case of frostbite considerably worse.
RYDIA-ICE_ROD.title: Ice Rod
RYDIA-ELEMENTAL_ROD.description: Whenever you have applied [gold]Burn[/gold], [blue]Freeze[/blue], and [gold]Shock[/gold], gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
RYDIA-ELEMENTAL_ROD.flavor: Fire, ice, lightning. Why make three trips?
RYDIA-ELEMENTAL_ROD.title: Elemental Rod
